objective: Continuously maximize scientifically credible progress toward (A) finding liquid assets with unusually strong evidence of very large upside over ~90 days, especially potential 2x+ moves, and (B) discovering at least one genuinely profitable after-cost algorithmic trading strategy.

use_for: bounded implementation where Luna is insufficient

api_sol.constraint: Use sparingly within the approved API budget; prefer deterministic/Luna/Terra when equivalent.

work_astra.setup: Scheduled ChatGPT Work tasks are enabled for this project; requested execution preference is GPT-6 Astra Medium, but the scheduler may not expose a pin to a specific execution model.

codex_astra.setup: Optional separate Codex automation/manual task; keep GitHub handoff canonical.

routing_rules.if: task can be answered by deterministic code/data without model judgment
routine low-risk interpretation or small bounded data task
medium-complexity research synthesis but not a large implementation
deep scientific decision, falsification, experiment design, or ambiguous high-value review
Astra task is unavailable or capacity-limited
routing_rules.then: checkpoint exact handoff in GitHub and continue independent deterministic/API work rather than stalling

task_selection.strategy_lane: Follow current strategy_discovery_queue and specialist coordination. Reject->learn->record->pivot. Exactly one expensive deep candidate.
task_selection.big_move_lane: Study historical 2x+ events reached within 90 days and matched controls; convert recurring pre-move precursors into predeclared tests. Rank current liquid assets only from timestamp-defensible evidence, reporting base rates, lift and uncertainty.
task_selection.arbitration: Choose the single action with highest expected information gain/economic value that does not duplicate active work. If one lane is waiting on future evidence, advance the other lane. Before recommending paid resources, apply the adaptive spending policy and prefer the lowest-cost option that resolves the measured bottleneck.

notify_on: strategy passes a major evidence gate
